text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Hah...
I never knew "dreams" could be so difficult...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you. Sorry for greeting the new year with such a grim face.
The truth is... take a look at this.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: How do you think you read the text in this photo?
Something was written in calligraphy on the hanshi paper. I could barely tell it was a single kanji character, but—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
It's "Dream"! "DREAM"!
Who on earth writes "Vines" for their first calligraphy of the year?!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Well, can't blame 'em.
No one could read handwriting like this.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I tried writing my New Year's resolution in a single kanji character――
but this doesn't feel punchy enough……

She takes good care of me, so at a time like this,
I want to be of help to her.
choice_data_list: Then why don't we do some New Year's calligraphy together?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Seriously!?
I'd really appreciate it if you could share some tips!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Is this the "Dream" you wrote?
Such lovely block script. Clear and remarkably easy to read!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: However, what must one do to write with brushstrokes as exquisite as yours...?
choice_data_list: It helps to focus on the stops, hooks, and sweeps.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Stops, hooks, sweeps... Does this mean I shouldn't write in a continuous stroke like cursive?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
All right, stop the brush where it needs to stop,
and flick where it needs to flick... With this――

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
It's complete!
My handwriting is still rather clumsy, but――

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: How's that? You can read it properly this time, right?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Heh, things are the opposite of usual today.
You really saved me back there.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
With your help, I was able to give shape to my New Year's resolution.
Looks like it's going to be a wonderful year!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Let's keep painting our "dreams" together this year too!
